description: Run with debug_verification_mode set to verify_vectors - enabling aggressive internal vector verification

skip_tests.reason: quack_serve returns a chunk whose vector size does not match, which this config verifies.

histogram_exact(x, bins ORDER BY y) raises 'List entry offset + length out of range' under verify_vectors: the binned histogram finalize verifies the whole result vector after writing one group while the sorted aggregate finalizes the groups one at a time. Reproduces on main without the group_by_top_key optimizer.
